translation:
Gegen Wan (葛根丸) treats wasting-thirst and wasting-kidney (消腎).

Pueraria root (葛根) (two liang), Trichosanthes fruit (栝蔞) (three liang), lead dan (鉛丹) (two liang), Aconite (附子) (one liang, the heavy one, parched, with skin and navel removed).

Grind the above four ingredients, sift into a fine powder, refine honey into pills the size of Wutong (梧桐) seeds; take ten pills each time, three times daily. It treats those who drink a great quantity of water daily.
translator_notes: 日飲碩水 rendered as 'drinks a great quantity of water daily' (碩 read as 'great').
